changelog: 🤖 Multi-CLI Coding Agent Suite: Full support for Antigravity (agy), Claude Code (claude), OpenCode (opencode), OpenAI Codex (codex), and Local SLM offline engine.
🎯 Multi-Agent Split Status Indicator: Dynamic top-bar status dot rendering per-agent health slices with quick-action menu (Server logs, daemon monitor, server restart).
⚙️ OpenCode Model Visibility Controls: Provider-level and per-model visibility switches to hide or show specific models across endpoints.
🛡️ Robust Codex Protocol Reconnection: Proactive auto-reconnect and state synchronization on WebSocket disconnections.
💬 Dedicated Agent Sheets & Setup Prompts: Native model pickers and setup guidance for Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex.
